name: pta-browser-plugin
description: 帮助学生完成 PTA 题目的浏览器插件（Chrome / Firefox）

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:chrome: rm -rf dist/chrome && ENTRY=background TARGET=chrome vite build && ENTRY=content TARGET=chrome vite build
scripts.build:firefox: rm -rf dist/firefox && ENTRY=background TARGET=firefox vite build && ENTRY=content TARGET=firefox vite build
scripts.smoke: node scripts/smoke.mjs chrome && node scripts/smoke.mjs firefox
